extension.summary: Browse public MDBList lists, play through Red Light
extension.description: Standalone browser for MDBList's Popular, Curated, and Official public lists, plus keyword search and paste-a-URL support. Requires Red Light (plugin.video.redlight) to be installed -- playback and all poster/plot/cast metadata are provided by Red Light's own TMDb-backed pipeline. Lists found here can also be exported as independent Red Light Personal Lists.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on does not host any content. It requires plugin.video.redlight to be installed and enabled, and depends on public, unauthenticated pages on mdblist.com.
